name: Overmorrow
original_integration_license: GPL-3.0-only; retain upstream headers and LICENSE, with LICENSE.VOLPAROSSA identifying new files
transport: Sequential same-origin GET /api/volparossa/forecast and /api/volparossa/air-quality; same public-community area, independent model runs and expiry; no acquisition or alternate network scheduler
scope: Actual standard provider, phone/tablet forecast views, hourly surface, air-quality card and detail route. Missing observations, daily products, alerts, radar, UV and AQI stay explicitly unavailable; native points are never interpolated into hours.
privacy: Loopback shared-provider origin only. No provider fallback, external imagery/fonts, location search or geolocation in the VOLPAROSSA profile. Network response size and time are bounded; no app weather persistence.
platform_status: Pinned web release build, sixteen synthetic Flutter tests and actual isolated Firefox interaction through the local HTTP bridge pass. Browser proof uses synthetic products and covers refresh, independent failures/expiry and the existing AQ detail route; core delivery remains unverified. Native Android/iOS packaging, lifecycle and home-screen widgets are not verified. Background/widget entry points fail closed instead of using upstream providers.
verification: No live weather acquisition, overlay delivery, accuracy or native platform proof claimed by this integration patch. Source schema and freshness validation do not attest upstream authenticity.
